title: Vedar — Kamchatka travel
description: Kamchatka travel: tours with availability, volcano/safety status, weather, stays, transfers, trip plans. Five state-changing tools: edit_trip_plan persists an anonymous 7-day draft by plan_id (no personal data); create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request and request_charter send the user's name/phone to the platform/operator/provider and require prior confirmation with consent:true. No online payment. Safety info cites source and update time; not a safety guarantee.

authentication.reason: Public endpoint, no credentials; initialize and tools/list verified without auth on 2026-10-19.

probe.reason: Unauthenticated initialize returned vedar-mcp 2.5.0 (protocol 2025-06-18); tools/list returned 20 tools, five with readOnlyHint=false (edit_trip_plan, create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request, request_charter). No request-creation tool was called.
